purpose: Read-only comparison of Cyrillic de curves and terminal construction. Foreign outlines, slant, dimensions and terminal cuts are not prescriptions for Instrument Serif Regular. No candidates are approved or newly drawn.

method.cmap: Check actual U+0434 exists; reject missing glyph fonts before proving outlines.
method.tested_features: Every available GSUB ssXX; every cvXX and aalt/salt setting 1..8; locl through native language shaping. Default features are HarfBuzz defaults.
method.normalization: All contact-sheet glyphs share one em size (1000 drawing units), from each complete font instance. No deslant, no independent glyph scaling. Native italic angles remain visible.
method.variable_font_instances: wght400; other axes at their stated source defaults. Proof labels show actual instance axes; source family/style naming remains separately recorded.
method.important_limitation: A dozen families does not establish a dozen skeletal types. Most Russian italic defaults here use an upper-return (delta-like) construction; the useful variation is in taper, terminal cuts, contour acceleration and bowl transition. Small-cap aalt outputs are documented but not accepted lowercase alternatives.
